# 🧩 Pull Request

## 📄 Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed.
Also include relevant motivation and context.

> Example:  
> This PR implements CRUD operations for the User entity, including basic validations and DTOs.

---

## 🧠 Type of Change

Select the type of change your code introduces:

- [ ] 🚀 Feature (new functionality)
- [ ] 🐞 Bug fix
- [ ] 🧹 Refactor (no new feature)
- [ ] 🧾 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚙️ Build / CI configuration

---

## 🔗 Related Issue

Closes #<issue-number>  
_(This automatically closes the linked issue when the PR is merged)_

---

## ✅ Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm:

- [ ] Code follows the project conventions
- [ ] Tests have been written and passed
- [ ] API documentation (Swagger or README) has been updated
- [ ] Branch name follows the convention (`feature/...`, `bugfix/...`, etc.)
- [ ] Commits are meaningful and well described

---

## 🧪 How to Test

Steps to verify that the feature or fix works as expected:

1. Run the application
2. Test endpoint `POST /api/v1/users`
3. Check that the response returns the correct data

---

## 🧾 Additional Notes

Anything else reviewers should know? (design decisions, TODOs, follow-up work, etc.)
